## More information
 
GEOTOOLS-RS2 is a 3 ECTS course given by the University of Geneva, as part of the [Complementary Certificate of Geomatics](https://www.unige.ch/cgeom/), the [Master in Environmental Sciences](https://www.unige.ch/muse/en), and the [Master in Earth Sciences](https://www.unige.ch/sciences/en/enseignements/formations/masters/earth).
